intro: A professional detail at a personal price, and we come to you. Serving Nashville since 2005.

mobile.title: Your driveway is our shop.
mobile.intro: We bring the detail to you, so your day keeps moving.

points.name: We come to you
points.text: Mobile service in Nashville and many areas beyond, including Brentwood, Franklin and Murfreesboro.

points.name: Quick turnaround
points.text: Express details run 30 to 45 minutes. Full details take about 1.5 to 2 hours.

points.name: No hidden fees
points.text: Rates are competitive and priced by vehicle size. Free estimates on request.

servicesTitle: Inside, outside, and everything that shines.
servicesIntro: Prices start at the amounts shown and depend on vehicle size: small, medium or large.

services.name: Express Mini
services.text: Hand wash, tires and rims, spray wax, windows, vacuum and dashboard in 30 to 45 minutes.

services.name: Interior Only "Deep Cleaning"
services.text: Vacuum, shampoo carpet, seats and mats, condition leather, and clean door jambs and windows.

services.name: Steam Wax Exterior Only
services.text: Hand wash, bug and tar removal, wax and tire dressing to keep paint glossy.

services.name: Elite Mini Detail
services.text: A full interior and exterior clean that brings back that showroom-floor look.

services.name: Ultimate Elite "Remove Swirl Marks"
services.text: Machine polish to remove swirl marks and leave a glossy exterior.

services.name: Extreme Elite "The Works"
services.text: Clay, machine buff, oxidation restoration, engine cleaning and a full interior shampoo.

why.name: Since 2005
why.text: Elite Detailing has been located in Nashville since 2005.

why.name: Personal attention
why.text: Friendly, professional, courteous staff who tailor the work to your vehicle.

why.name: Straight pricing
why.text: Competitive rates with no hidden fees, and a free estimate on request.

whyTitle: The detail is in the name.
howTitle: A clean vehicle in three steps.

steps.name: Book
steps.text: Book online or by phone and stay updated the whole way.

steps.name: We detail
steps.text: Our experts inspect your vehicle and detail it with high-quality products and tools.

steps.name: You approve
steps.text: Inspect the result, make sure you're satisfied, then pay.
